card.title: BT-7
card.flavorText: The BT 7 was a light tank and was produced between 1935 and 1940. It was nicknamed “Betka and/or Betushka” and was the last one of the BT series of Soviet cavalry tanks. In 1940 the BT 7 was more or less replaced by the T-34 medium tank.
